name: mcai-webapp
description: Publish an HTML page as a Google Apps Script web app under your own Workspace account and give it a branded mcai.dev short link — org-only or public, your choice. All you need is an mcai.dev API key. Every command runs on your own Mac through a local terminal (the Desktop Commander connector in Cowork, the Bash tool in Claude Code), never in a sandbox. Updates redeploy in place so the /exec URL and the short link never change.
